pack.name: Data Classification & Lineage
pack.description: Classification tiers and cross-boundary data-flow documentation themes.

rules.title: Data classification taxonomy documented
rules.description: Organization classification levels (public, internal, confidential, restricted) must be defined and referenced in architecture.
rules.remediationGuidance: Publish taxonomy in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.ComplianceTags for reviewer alignment.

rules.title: Classification applied to every datastore
rules.description: Each datastore must carry a classification tag — unclassified production datastores block governance assessment.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag datastores[].Tags with classification tier; cross-check datastores[] inventory in manifest.

rules.title: Classification propagated to services
rules.description: Services processing classified data must document highest data tier handled — not understate sensitivity.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag max-classification on services[].Tags; align with ReadsFrom/WritesTo edges to datastores.

rules.title: Data owner assigned per domain
rules.description: Each major data domain must name a business data owner accountable for classification and access decisions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record data-owner tags in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Lineage map for critical data flows
rules.description: Tier-1 data elements must document source-to-consumer lineage across services, ETL, and analytics.
rules.remediationGuidance: Draw lineage in metadata.ChangeDescription; enumerate flows on relationships[].relationshipType.

rules.title: Cross-boundary transfer documented
rules.description: Data crossing security zones, tenants, or regions must document legal, contractual, and technical controls.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document cross-boundary transfers on relationships[] and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Retention period per classification tier
rules.description: Retention and disposal schedules must align to classification — not indefinite storage by default.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture retention in governance.PolicyConstraints and datastores[].Tags.

rules.title: Legal hold and litigation hold themes
rules.description: Systems subject to hold must document suspension of deletion without undermining broader retention policy.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note legal-hold capability in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Data minimization at collection
rules.description: Ingestion points must document field-level collection rationale — avoid hoarding unneeded attributes.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe minimization in services[].Purpose and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Pseudonymization and tokenization paths
rules.description: Analytics and lower environments should document pseudonymization before secondary use of sensitive data.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag pseudonymization approach on datastores[].Tags and downstream services[].Tags.

rules.title: Master data management boundaries
rules.description: Golden records and MDM hubs must be identified so duplicate or conflicting lineage is avoided.
rules.remediationGuidance: Identify MDM systems in services[].ServiceName and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Metadata catalog integration
rules.description: Architecture should reference Purview, Collibra, or equivalent catalog for automated lineage where deployed.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag catalog integration in services[].Tags and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Schema evolution and breaking change control
rules.description: Shared datasets must document schema versioning and consumer notification for breaking changes.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe schema governance in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Data quality rules for critical attributes
rules.description: Key business attributes must document validation, completeness, and quality monitoring expectations.
rules.remediationGuidance: List data quality rules in governance.RequiredControls and services[].Tags for ETL/validation services.

rules.title: Sensitive data discovery and tagging
rules.description: Platforms should document how new sensitive columns are discovered and classified (Purview scans, DLP).
rules.remediationGuidance: Record discovery tooling in governance.RequiredControls; align with azureExtractor Purview references if present.

rules.title: Access controls aligned to classification
rules.description: Higher classifications must document stricter access (MFA, PIM, ABAC) proportional to sensitivity.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map access tier to classification in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.RequiredControls.

rules.title: Encryption requirements by classification
rules.description: Confidential and restricted tiers must document encryption at rest and in transit with key custody.
rules.remediationGuidance: Align encryption tags on datastores[].Tags with classification tier in governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Masking and redaction for lower environments
rules.description: Non-production must document masking rules preventing full-fidelity sensitive data in dev/test.
rules.remediationGuidance: Tag environment data handling on datastores[].Tags and services[].Tags.

rules.title: Third-party data sharing register
rules.description: Outbound sharing with partners must enumerate datasets, classification, purpose, and agreement status.
rules.remediationGuidance: List recipients on external WritesTo edges and governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Data residency and sovereignty constraints
rules.description: Region placement for classified data must document residency requirements and prohibited jurisdictions.
rules.remediationGuidance: Capture residency in governance.PolicyConstraints and services[].Tags with region metadata.

rules.title: Archive and tiering strategy
rules.description: Cold/archive tiers must document retrieval latency, cost, and classification-appropriate controls.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe tiering in datastores[].Tags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Secure deletion and crypto-shredding
rules.description: Disposal of restricted data must document secure wipe or crypto-shredding when keys are destroyed.
rules.remediationGuidance: Note disposal method in governance.RequiredControls and datastores[].Tags.

rules.title: BI and analytics lineage to source
rules.description: Dashboards and ML features must trace back to authoritative sources — not undocumented copies.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document analytics lineage in metadata.ChangeDescription and relationships[] to warehouse/lake.

rules.title: Event streaming lineage (Kafka, Event Hubs)
rules.description: Stream processors must document topic schemas, retention, and downstream consumers for auditability.
rules.remediationGuidance: Map streaming edges on relationships[]; tag topics in services[].Tags.

rules.title: API payload classification
rules.description: Public APIs must document maximum classification of fields returned and filtering for scoped tokens.
rules.remediationGuidance: Describe API data scope in services[].Purpose and governance.PolicyConstraints.

rules.title: Data steward escalation path
rules.description: Classification disputes and reclassification requests must have documented steward workflow.
rules.remediationGuidance: Record steward contacts in governance.ComplianceTags and metadata.ChangeDescription.

rules.title: Periodic classification recertification
rules.description: Classifications must be reviewed on schedule — stale labels undermine access and retention controls.
rules.remediationGuidance: Add recertification cadence to governance.ComplianceTags.

rules.title: Lineage evidence for regulatory inquiry
rules.description: Architecture must support exporting lineage and classification evidence for audit — not tribal knowledge only.
rules.remediationGuidance: Ensure catalog/lineage tooling referenced in governance.RequiredControls and metadata.ChangeDescription.
